cs.t: Indeed. Seems much more similar to Intel's RealSense L515, which was a tiny Lidar package. 1024x768@30fps, only 9m range thought; 20m/40m outdoors/indoors sounds impressive! I think mine retailed for like $300 at the time? Am curious what the applications for this are. Is this for drones? is this for auto-focus and or auto tracking? Thinking of Insta360's new addon for their small gimbal, which adds auto tracking; maybe similar uses?  https://www.theverge.com/news/614366/insta360-flow-2-pro-ai-...  Sony may not really know to be fair! On the very low end, I'd mention the very affordable single chip 8x8 pixel 4m depth vl53l5cx. Used by ETH Zurich on a swarm of very lightweight mapping drones!  https://www.st.com/en/imaging-and-photonics-solutions/vl53l5...   https://hackaday.com/2024/10/11/tiny-drones-do-distributed-m...
